text:
maria: Heads-up — after the 2051 runtime roll we saw a 12% p99 latency regression on medium-length chat (seq ~1024). Traces point at increased KV cache ejection churn + more small batches hitting the slow kernel. I sketched an admit/ramp idea, want quick feedback before I open an experiment PR.

sam: ugh, saw that too on smoke. Is the KV keeper evicting too agressively under token pressure?

maria: yeah. current ejection: evict when free_tokens < threshold (static). But with variable seq distribution it thrashes. Proposal: proportional ejection + token-bucket admit with soft ramp. High-level: 1) track per-shard kv_hit_rate (exponential decay) 2) compute desired_kv_reserve = f(kv_hit_rate, recent_seq_p50) 3) allow ejection only if free_tokens > desired_kv_reserve * alpha 4) admission uses token-bucket that increases target tokens over warmup window instead of a step.

jing: sketch the math?

maria: sure, pseudo:```python
# every 10s
kv_hit_rate = exp_decay(kv_hits, kv_lookback)
seq_med = hist.percentile(50)
desired_reserve = base_reserve * (1 + (1 - kv_hit_rate)) * (seq_med/512)
allow_evict = free_tokens > desired_reserve * 0.8
# admission tokens
bucket.target = lerp(min_tokens, max_tokens, warmup_progress)
if request.tokens <= bucket.available: admit else soft_reject(429-soft)
```

ben: sounds sensible. Two flags though: 1) alpha tuning (0.8) needs perf islands; 2) we should measure tail before/after per-kernel. Could add metric: kv_evicts_per_min and kv_reloads_per_min.

maria: yep adding those. Also plan to try a conservative roll: enable on 10% of hosts, route ~5% of traffic, collect p50/p95/p99, small-batch fraction, kernel switch counts.

perf-bot: experiment created: exp/kv-admit-ramp-205123 — variant A (conservative), B (aggressive). dashboards linked: https://dash.redwood/exp/kv-admit-ramp-205123

sam: what's the fallback if we mis-tune and see increased user 429s?

maria: automatic backoff: if p99_latency_up > 10% OR 429_rate > 0.5% in 5m window, rollout auto-reverts. We'll also ship a diagnostic event with last-kv-state and admission_bucket_level for traces.

ben: also check kernel selection logs — slower kernel is often chosen when seq estimate undercounts tokens. Maybe feed admission sequence estimate into kernel-hint.

maria: good call. I'll add 'seq_hint' to admission record. Final ask: who can review a short PR with the admit function + metrics? I'll open it in ~30m.

jing: I'll take review + help wire the dashboards.

sam: I can do the canary rollout gating and infra config.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary cluster 3, batcher version 2051.2 (patch: kv-eject-adaptive).

maria: thanks — will post PR link shortly and drop a tl;dr in the release channel. :rocket:
